title: Fix the Broken Print Statement
description: The program should print a greeting message. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print Hello, World! to the console.
actualProblem: The string literal is missing its closing double quote, which causes a SyntaxError before the program can even run.
explanation: Every string literal in Python must be closed with a matching quote character. Without the closing quote, the parser cannot tell where the string ends and raises a SyntaxError.
